summary: Sandbach United got their 2026/27 season off to a winning start with a 1-0 victory over Stafford Town, with Stan Tattersall netting the decisive goal in the first half. The Bach secured a clean sheet in the process, making for a battling performance against a resilient opponent. Tattersall has since been sponsored by Calibre Control, with Paul from the company continuing their support of the club.
